paragraphs: Swamiji described an Indian custom called 'protection'. A woman may send a small bracelet of silk thread to a man, and once he accepts it, he becomes her brother, bound to stand by her.

He then told of a beautiful Rajput girl, the daughter of a chieftain, who lived during the reign of the last Mogul emperor, the harsh ruler who brought that brilliant empire to ruin. Having heard of her beauty, the emperor ordered that she be brought to his harem.

A messenger arrived carrying the emperor's portrait and showed it to her. She threw it down, stamped on it and told him that this was how a Rajput girl treated his Mogul emperor. In reply, the imperial army marched into Rajputana.

Facing disaster, she came up with a plan. She sent silken bracelets to many Rajput princes, each with a simple plea to come and help. Every one of them answered. The Rajputs gathered together, and the emperor's forces had to turn back.
learn: Courage is not only defiance; it is also knowing when to ask for help and how to unite people around a cause. A small symbol of trust, sincerely given, can bring together strength no single person has alone.
